# Every refusal is local; the suite's counted HTTP endpoint must see zero calls.
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only
stderr '--result-only requires --attempt N greater than zero'
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt 0
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --attempt 1
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --attempt 0
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt -1
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt 4294967296
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt 1 --logs-only
stderr 'choose only one'
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt 1 --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal
! skygo jobs prune --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z --result-only --attempt 1 --ack-unverified-terminal
! skygo jobs prune --result-only --attempt 1
stderr 'prune requires --before'
! skygo jobs prune --result-only --attempt 1 --obligation 11111111111111111111111111111111 --page-size 1
stderr '--obligation requires'
! skygo jobs prune --result-only --attempt 1 --obligation 11111111111111111111111111111111 --before 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z
! skygo jobs prune --result-only --attempt 1 --obligation 11111111111111111111111111111111 --page-token opaque
